s:
Which of the following statements related to latitude are true?

I. Rainfall, temperature and vegetation vary with latitude.

II. The difference between the longest day and the shortest day increases with latitude.

III. Indira Point is located approximately at 6° 45 ′ Nlatitude.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
src: CDS 2017
x: Climate and vegetation vary with latitude, and the gap between the longest and shortest day widens with latitude, so I and II are true; Indira Point lies at about 6°45'N, so III is also true. (Two printed options repeat 'I and II only'.)

s: Which of the following has the maximum velocity of rotation?

s:
Which statement is not true about Indian Time Zone?

a. India currently has just one time zone, Indian Standard Time calculated on the basis of 82.5 E longitude.

b. India's Time Zones were first established in 1884.

c. Originally there were two time zones, Bombay Time and Calcutta Time.

d. Calcutta time was 4 hours and 51 minutes ahead of GMT, while Bombay time was 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of GMT.
src: APPSC Assistant Director of Economics, Assistant Commissione
x: Statement d is false: it swaps the offsets – Calcutta Time was about GMT + 5 h 53 min and Bombay Time GMT + 4 h 51 min. India's zones were set in 1884 (Bombay and Calcutta time), and today it has one zone, IST on 82.5°E.

s:
Consider the following statements-

a. The Godavari Arch Bridge is the latest of the five bridges that span the Godavari River at Rajahmundry.

b. The bridge is located in two channels, the Kovvur channel and the Rajahmundry channel, and hence the bridge is also known as the Kovvur-Rajahmundry Bridge.
Which of the above statement's is/are correct?
src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
x: The Godavari Arch Bridge (1997) is not the latest Godavari bridge at Rajahmundry (the fourth bridge came in 2015), but it spans the Kovvur and Rajahmundry channels and is called the Kovvur–Rajahmundry Bridge: only b.

s: In which year was PIN code introduced?
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: The six-digit Postal Index Number (PIN) was introduced on 15 August 1972.

s: Which of the following is a traditional method of TV broadcasting?
src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer General S
x: Terrestrial (over-the-air) transmission from ground transmitters is the traditional method of TV broadcasting; cable, satellite (DTH) and IPTV came later.

s:
Consider the following statements about 'Longest Electrified Railway Tunnel':

a. The total length of the tunnel is 6.6 kms and is situated between Cherlopalli and Rapuru stations.

b. The tunnel is part of the recently completed Obulavaripalli-Venkatachalam new railway line.

c. The longest electrified tunnel in Indian Railways was commissioned by South Eastern Railway.
Which of the statements are correct?
src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
x: The 6.6-km Cherlopalli-Rapuru tunnel (SPSR Nellore) is on the Obulavaripalle-Venkatachalam new line, so a and b are correct; it was built and commissioned by South Central Railway, not South Eastern Railway.

s: Which of the following statements is/are correct about branches of Life Sciences? A.Astrobiology is the study of bacteria. B.Anatomy, a field in the biological sciences concerned with the identification and description of the body structures of living things. C.Biotechnology uses living cells to develop or manipulate products for specific purposes, such as genetically modified foods.
src: APPSC 2021 Mains Executive Officer Grade-III
x: B and C are correct: anatomy describes body structures, and biotechnology uses living cells to make or modify products such as GM foods. A is wrong: astrobiology studies the origin and possibility of life in the universe, while bacteria are studied in bacteriology.

s:
Which of the following statements are correct?

I. Change in magnetic field produces induced current.

II. Flow of current in a conductor produces magnetic field.

III. Magnetic field related to coil can be produced by motion between conductor and coil.
src: SSC 2018
x: All three statements describe electromagnetism: a changing field or relative motion between magnet/conductor and coil induces current, and current produces a magnetic field.

s: Which of the following hormones is secreted by "Beta cells" of pancreas.
src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
x: Beta cells of the islets of Langerhans in the pancreas secrete insulin; alpha cells secrete glucagon.

x: Unkeyed: 'detoxification' (removing a toxic substance under supervision) is the first stage of treating both drug and alcohol dependence, so options 1 and 2 are equally right and no official key was found.

s: Which of these is the energy conversion that happens in the process called photosynthesis?
src: SSC CGL 2019

s: Which of the following vitamins decomposes easily on heating?
src: APPSC AE (Subordinate Services) Mains General Studies & Ment
x: Vitamin C is the vitamin most easily destroyed by heat (and by oxidation). The B group is partly heat-stable, and A and E are fat-soluble and more stable in cooking.
